body: The Reformed Church in America, with Wes Granberg-Michaelson at the helm, recently made the historic decision to adopt the Belhar Confession . If you don’t know why this is so significant, you can read about it here. Denominations often receive a lot of critique, but this decision – to me at least – reflects the best of what historic denominations can be and do.
